{{Short description|Finnish mathematician (born 1944)}}

'''Ulla Irmeli Pursiheimo''' (born 4 May 1944){{r|ww}} is a Finnish mathematician who became the first female mathematics professor in Finland.{{r|mathhist|em}} Her areas of interest in mathematics include [[mathematical optimization]], [[control theory]], [[search game]]s, and later in her career [[mathematics education]].{{r|mathhist|em}}

Pursiheimo earned her doctorate from the [[University of Turku]] in 1971. Her dissertation, ''Optimization of Search With Constant Spreading Speed of Effort'', was supervised by {{ill|Olavi Hellman|fi}}.{{r|mgp}}
She became a full professor of mathematics at the University of Turku in 1974,{{r|ww}} and retired to become a [[professor emerita]] in 1999.{{r|mathhist|em}}
